findings.title: ResourceQuota requires a request or limit the pods do not set
findings.cause: Deployment kd-quota-requires-limits/web cannot create pods: ResourceQuota compute puts a quota on limits.memory, which the API server can only count when every container sets it, and container web sets no resources.limits.memory. The quota is not used up: the pods are refused for leaving the field out

evidence.detail: (combined from similar events): Error creating: pods "web-6d754df847-6nht2" is forbidden: failed quota: compute: must specify limits.memory for: web

evidence.command: kubectl get resourcequota compute -n kd-quota-requires-limits -o jsonpath='{.status.hard}'
kubectl get deployment web -n kd-quota-requires-limits -o jsonpath='{range .spec.template.spec.containers[*]}{.name}{" "}{.resources}{"\n"}{end}'

findings.fix: Set resources.limits.memory on the containers named, or add a LimitRange to the namespace with a default for it, so that containers which set none are given one.
